message.content:
So `png_u32max` is 0x7FFFFFFF (2147483647), and the chunk length in the crashers is 0x3FFFFFFF (1073741823), which is half of `png_u32max`. This is the maximum chunk length that passes the check `if(chunk.length > png_u32max) return SPNG_ECHUNK_SIZE;`.

Now let me understand the vulnerability. The "huge chunk" crashers have a chunk with a very large length (0x3FFFFFFF) that causes issues. Let me look at how these chunks are processed.
